supporting.summary: Asserts the six-level order, the required level per reference kind, and that grading moves from declared to mapped to complete only with qualifying records.
EvidenceLedger and EvidenceRecord define the strict schema version 1 ledger; ADR 0003 documents it.
Asserts reconciliation cites supporting records, lists unverified criteria, reports orphaned records, and leaves classifications unchanged.
dag-tool reconcile --evidence run on this repository: each intent record grades its criteria, cites supporting records and lists the unverified ones.
